actual: The active Codex MCP tool snapshot omitted both fields even though commit b4bc9116 had already added them to the gateway module. Restarting FastAPI did not refresh the client-owned MCP schema snapshot.

description: A long-lived Codex MCP session continued to expose the pre-b4bc9116 custom_evo tool schemas after the repository and FastAPI runtime were updated. Fresh gateway introspection exposes both fields correctly, so the remaining defect is stale client schema activation plus missing end-to-end schema regression coverage.
